title: Editable calendar categories, a 50-icon picker, and Gmail-style auto-categorization rules
summary: Calendar categories (Assignment, School Event, Club, Sports, Event) are no longer hardcoded -- add, rename, recolor, re-icon, reorder, and delete categories from Calendar Settings. Assignment can't be deleted since it's tied to the Canvas/CVA pipeline, but its color/icon/label are still editable.

New 50-icon library and picker (calendar, star, trophy, book, flask, music, paw print, and dozens more) replaces the old 4 hardcoded glyphs -- pick any icon for any category, shown in every dot, the legend, and reminder/countdown tags.

New ordered auto-categorization rules ('if from [calendar] and title contains [keywords] -> label as [category]') replace the old hardcoded sports-keyword regex. A built-in Sports rule is seeded automatically so existing users see identical categorization after the update.

Each external calendar feed now has its own default category, used when no rule matches its events -- set from a new dropdown in External Calendars settings, migrated automatically from the old Club/Holiday feed flags.

Reminders and countdowns attached to a category now show that category's real icon (not just a color dot), and the category picker for reminders lists your actual categories instead of the old fixed 5.
